what: Live supervised GREG body (greg run) anchoring its ledger head at an RFC 3161 TSA after a founder-signed ANCHOR_CONFIGURE, across a SIGKILL restart
reality_status: LOCAL-REAL against a loopback OpenSSL RFC 3161 TSA (openssl ts -reply, throwaway root). Public TSAs (timestamp.sigstore.dev, freetsa.org, digicert) were refused by the build container's egress proxy (HTTP 403 to CONNECT). Not MAC-VERIFIED; not founder-used; test founder key.
sequence: greg init / founder keygen / founder enroll (test key)
greg anchor configure (signed) + engineering-brief mission on local Kernel/DALEOBANKS/WMI checkouts
first anchor attempt FAILED: ledger head carries a 'sha256:' prefix (negative evidence below); mission still achieved
fix committed; kill -9 770; body restarted on the fixed code (boot 2)
next due tick anchored the head; `greg anchor verify` -> VERIFIED
body stopped with `greg stop --local` (clean exit 0); rewrite attack run on a copy of its ledger -> REWRITTEN, exit 3

rewrite_attack_on_live_ledger.method: copy of the live body home; edited the greg.mission.achieved record (seq 45 of 62) and recomputed every later hash with the ledger's own v2 formula

witness_boundary_2026-09-26.finding: The ledger-internal verifier (anchor.verify) reads anchors AND TSA roots from the ledger it checks. A complete ledger rewriter defeats it. Reproduced on this live ledger via the CLI: anchor deletion (B) and rollback (C) return exit 0. The earlier rewrite result (A) proved only: an anchored prefix cannot be edited and re-chained undetectably while the anchor record and configuration are left in place.
witness_boundary_2026-09-26.fix: `greg anchor export --roots R --out W` writes a witness bundle outside GREG's home (refused inside it); `greg anchor verify --witness W --roots R` checks the presented ledger using only the retained bundle and the verifier's own TSA root, and never reads the ledger's proof.* records.

live_cli_results.control: VERIFIED (1 witnessed head, 5 later records uncovered)

witness_boundary_2026-09-26.unit_tests: tests/unit/test_greg_anchor_witness.py: A-F each FAILED against the retained witness; the ledger-internal verifier accepts B, C, D.
witness_boundary_2026-09-26.mutation: Replacing verify_witness with a verifier that derives witness and roots from the presented ledger makes attacks B, C, D, E and F succeed (5 of 10 witness tests fail); A is caught either way.
